hypothesis: A fresh independent cold start with the same route and planner may distinguish a run-specific EGO inflated-occupancy collision from a repeatable route-feasibility failure. #355 succeeded but lacked complete terminal observers; #356 captured all evidence but EGO repeatedly collided and aborted after 2.60 m.

sole_changed_factor.parameter: independent SITL cold start and resulting fresh VINS/map epoch
sole_changed_factor.from_previous_run: #356 new VINS epoch/map and generated map from an independent Gazebo/PX4 start.
sole_changed_factor.to: Another independent Gazebo/PX4/VINS/map start; no flight source, planner, goal, health threshold, or observer behavior change.

decision_rule: If target dwell and 600 simulated-second ACTIVE hold complete with all terminal observers, retain the result as a diagnostic calibration sample. If the same planner_full_curve_planning_failed occurs before target, stop repeating this route and switch to a no-flight/read-only inflated-occupancy collision diagnostic. Do not change collision policy or health thresholds.

held_fixed.goal: Same +16.0 m ENU, +0.10 m, +0.20 rad single goal; 3 s arrival dwell; 600 simulated-second ACTIVE hold.
held_fixed.observer_lifecycle: terminal flight.json marker, 1500 wall-second upper bound

analyzer_staging: The driver copies the prepared analyzer into the run directory and checks its SHA-256 against this frozen protocol before preflight. This addresses the #356 postprocessing staging omission.

procedure.safe_stop: Stop only after independent 6 s readback confirms bridge LANDED or DISABLED, landed=true, armed=false, control_enabled=false, vehicle remained disarmed and zero control samples.
